issues.description: The driver merges on company_OSHA, year, zipcode_OSHA and open_year, while the bounded packaged-linktable probe found company_OSHA, year, zipcode_OSHA and gvkey. The intended year/open_year semantics and compatible key contract remain unresolved.

The helper generates num_repeat_viol and num_willful_viol while the driver refers to num_repeat and num_willful; the BoardEx block also generates longer count identifiers and later refers to shorter forms. Stata permits unique prefixes when abbreviation is enabled, but the supplied source does not establish the author session's abbreviation setting or variable namespace at those points.

The driver executes cd Data at line 1, so the full file must be launched from the parent of Data for that relative change to occur once. Starting the full file while already inside Data would resolve into Data/Data. The helper include is relative to the resulting Data directory although the package copy is at the package root; the inspection/violation intermediate is saved in the current directory and then loaded from OSHA/, and the non-OSHA producer path differs from the current-directory consumer.

The main stream at original lines 3–344 consumes ibes_aggregated, director_independence_year and non_OSHA_violations before the supplied producers at original lines 357–431. In a working copy, move the complete producer blocks after setup lines 1–2 and before main line 3, then launch the reordered full file from the parent of Data so cd Data occurs once. Preserve the main stream through its final save at original line 344.

The full supplied workflow reads separate OSHA CSV chunks, two distinct Compustat paths, prepared ReferenceUSA, I/B/E/S and CUSIP mapping inputs, two BoardEx inputs, historical-parent Violation Tracker data and two CIK lists. Most exact tables are absent from this package; candidate products, user entitlements, field mappings and full coverage remain unverified. The I/B/E/S map's raw fyear mapping and the non-OSHA three-year field origin are separately unresolved source contracts.

The I/B/E/S source is collapsed by cusip/fpedats and adds fyear_end_month/fyear_end_year, then merges the CUSIP crosswalk. The following rename fyear year requires a raw fyear value from that crosswalk or another author-supported producer; the supplied block does not establish a fiscal-year rule.

The supplied Violation Tracker producer groups and saves annual penalties_not_OSHA by CIK/year. The main stream later refers to penalties_not_OSHA_3year at lines 337 and 340. Its origin, history and author-defined missing/zero and year-alignment conventions are not established by this annual producer; keep the field origin unresolved without assuming it is absent from an unseen prepared source.

The raw matching-export stanza renames estab_name to company_OSHA and site_zip to zipcode_OSHA at lines 97–98, then line 104 selects the former names. The actual namespace after import/rename and whether this candidate export is selected when the packaged hand-checked linktable is used are not established. This is a conditional precondition, not a confirmed missing-column blocker or a requirement to reconstruct fuzzy matches.

evidence.quote:
“The Impact of Information Frictions Within Regulators:
     Evidence from Workplace Safety Violations”

evidence.description: The authors identify the supplied preparation driver, included helper, linktable, and identifier list.
evidence.quote:
Code (Item #5)
We attach two Stata .do files which contain the code used to transform our raw data into the
final dataset used for our analyses. The primary file, data_preprocessing_FSY.do, merges and
cleans the various raw datasets and constructs variables from these datasets used in our
analyses. This file calls another .do file from within it, aggregate_osha_violation_v2.do, which
is also enclosed. The code is commented in detail but please feel free to contact the authors
with any questions.

We also attach two additional files. The first is our OSHA-to-Compustat linktable, assembled
via fuzzy matching plus hand-verification of all proposed matches outputted by the fuzzy
matching process. (For researchers who wish to use OSHA data beyond 2019, we would
recommend supplementing our file with additional fuzzy matching for observations outside
of our sample period).

The second is a text file containing all distinct gvkeys used in our primary sample.

evidence.description: The helper comment states its intended call context; the datasheet separately identifies the supplied driver that calls it.
evidence.quote:
*** THIS FILE SHOULD BE CALLED FROM WITHIN osha_descriptives_20_04_16.do. IT IS NOT A STANDALONE FILE!!! ****
* The code below processes raw osha_violation... csv files so that there is one obs per activity_nr

evidence.description: The main driver sets a Data working directory, imports the first violation chunk, invokes the supplied helper, and saves an intermediate.
evidence.quote:
cd Data // change this to file path where data is housed

******* PREPROCESS VIOLATION DATA ************
* Begin with the raw OSHA violation data (all downloaded 04/2020)
** Raw OSHA violation data is downloaded in multiple files from OSHA website due to size

import delimited using osha_violation12.csv, clear 
sort activity_nr

// for formatting compatability w/older files, need to make these vars strings -- though we never actually use these vars
	tostring abate_complete, replace 
	tostring emphasis, replace
	tostring hazcat, replace
	tostring fta_issuance_date, replace
	tostring fta_contest_date, replace
	tostring fta_final_order_date, replace

* One activity_nr can have multiple violations, each with its own row. The routine provided in the do-file below aggregates the violation data to the activity_nr level
do aggregate_osha_violation_v2.do 

save osha_violations_by_activity_nr, replace

evidence.description: The included helper emits the actual violation-count names and one row per activity number.
evidence.quote:
keep activity_nr num_repeat_viol num_willful_viol current_pen_tot *_current_pen_tot 
duplicates drop // should now have 1 obs per activity_nr
gen has_violation = 1

evidence.description: The driver derives open_year and merges the packaged OSHA linktable using four named keys.
evidence.quote:
gen open_year = substr(open_date,1,4)
	destring open_year, replace
	drop if open_year < 1997
rename estab_name company_OSHA
rename site_zip zipcode_OSHA 

save osha_inspection_ID_info_all, replace // full OSHA inspection data -- reload this shortly

** Now export OSHA inspection info for fuzzy matching + hand-checking of matches
keep if owner_type == "A" // private firms only
keep activity_nr reporting_id host_est_key estab_name site_state site_address site_zip sic_code naics_code mail_street mail_zip open_date


** The below file, after fuzzy matching and hand checking, ultimately yields the linktable in OSHA_compustat_linktable.dta
export delim using osha_inspection_ID_info_all.csv, replace
** It's sufficient to fuzzy match the inspection data; this can be merged to violation data using activity_nr
** To fuzzy match, we rely on an initial match - for which we hand-verified matches - done by Rich Puchalsky. We supplemented this with further matching to ReferenceUSA done using Stata's reclink command, again hand-checking all matches. 


*** Read back in inspection data, merge with linktable that resulted from hand checks of fuzzy matches
u osha_inspection_ID_info_all.dta, clear

merge company_OSHA year zipcode_OSHA open_year using OSHA_compustat_linktable.dta // linktable is hand-checked output, derived from csv file exported above

evidence.description: The later section creates ibes_aggregated from the detail input and a separate CUSIP–GVKEY link input.
evidence.quote:
**********************************************************************************
************ IBES ******************
use "ibes_EPS_DETAIL_2000_2019.dta", clear
	rename *, lower
	drop if cusip == ""
	keep if measure == "EPS"

rename actual actual_street 
rename value mean_forecast_street // prior to collapse command 
drop if cusip == ""
gsort cusip fpedats analys -anndats -anntims // keep last forecast by each analyst
	duplicates drop cusip fpedats analys , force 

* Drop forecasts made > 180 days and < 4 days before announcement date, following Caskey and Ozel 2017
gen forecast_timing = anndats_act - anndats
keep if ((forecast_timing >= 4) & (forecast_timing <= 180))

collapse (mean) mean_forecast_street actual_street, by(cusip fpedats )
	* Fiscal year end year/month, for merging with gvkeys
	gen fyear_end_year = year(fpedats)
	gen fyear_end_month = month(fpedats)

rename cusip ncusip
merge 1:1 ncusip fyear_end_month fyear_end_year using cusip_gvkey_linktable, keep(3)
	drop _merge
	drop if gvkey == . 

rename fyear year
keep gvkey year mean_forecast_street actual_street 

save ibes_aggregated, replace

evidence.description: The first Compustat path is merged by gvkey and year and supplies fiscal-date information for matching OSHA events.
evidence.quote:
* First, merge to Compustat to correctly match fiscal year to violations. (Then drop - we will merge with Compustat again later post-aggregation to get control vars)
	so gvkey year
	merge m:1 gvkey year using Compustat_all_1995_2019, keep(3)
		drop _merge		
		keep activity_nr - open_date_statafmt datadate_statafmt 
		gen distance_to_end = datadate_statafmt - open_date_statafmt
		replace year = year + 1 if distance_to_end < 0 // if fiscal year t ends before calendar year t
		replace year = year - 1 if distance_to_end > 365

evidence.description: The later financial-control code uses these Compustat fields and creates lagged measures.
evidence.quote:
* some basic financial information
xtset firmstate_enc year
capture gen roa = ni/l1.at
	winsor roa, p(0.01) gen(roa_wins) // just to eyeball - winsorize again before running regs
gen lev = dltt/at
	winsor lev, p(0.01) gen(lev_wins) // just to eyeball - winsorize again before running regs
gen roe = ni/(l1.prcc_f * l1.csho)
	winsor roe, p(0.01) gen(roe_wins) // just to eyeball - winsorize again before running regs
gen mkt_to_book = prcc_f/bkvlps 
	winsor mkt_to_book, p(0.01) gen(mtb_wins) // just to eyeball - winsorize again before running regs
rename sich sic4
	gen sic2 = floor(sic4/100)
gen lassets = log(at)

evidence.quote:
******* PREPROCESS INSPECTION DATA ************

Stata 18 and the winsor command are available by metadata. No author program was run, no Stata name-resolution/syntax probe was run, and no computed result or execution claim is made.

A narrow CRSP CCM catalog selection found link-history tables with gvkey/security and effective-date fields; their selected metadata did not include the CUSIP and fiscal-period keys required by the supplied prepared crosswalk, so no compatible local substitute is claimed.

The visible non-OSHA producer creates annual penalties_not_OSHA, while the main stream later uses penalties_not_OSHA_3year. Its source/history and missing/zero/year-gap conventions remain a scoped unresolved origin question, not a confirmed missing-variable blocker or a proposed formula.
